title: InletScope: Multiscale pressure-based inlet unstart monitoring under changing sensor configurations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supersonic inlets capture and compress air for aeroengines, and unstart can disrupt the air supply and compromise propulsion-system stability. Pressure-based monitoring must accommodate flow responses that vary with operating condition and measurement location. InletScope combines shared multiscale pressure encoding, learned scale fusion and sensor-probability averaging, allowing measurement sets to change without retraining. Separate models evaluate unstart detection and new-onset prediction within a 0.5-s future interval. Seven Mach-2.9 runs, each with one annotated event, cover downstream throttling, throat regulation and splitter adjustment; three are held out with fixed weights and source-derived settings. Across three training seeds, full-sensor detection achieves run-wise mean window $F_1$ scores of 0.834--0.964. translated_title: InletScope：基于多尺度压力的变化传感器配置下进气道不起动监测
translated_abstract: 超音速进气道为航空发动机捕获并压缩空气，不起动（unstart）现象会中断空气供应并危及推进系统的稳定性。基于压力的监测必须适应随运行工况和测量位置变化的流动响应。InletScope 结合了共享的多尺度压力编码、可学习的尺度融合以及传感器概率平均，使得测量集合无需重新训练即可发生变化。采用独立的模型分别评估不起动检测与未来0.5秒间隔内的新发事件预测。七个马赫2.9的试验各包含一个标注事件，涵盖下游节流、喉道调节和分流器调整；其中三个试验作为留出测试集，使用固定权重和源自动训练数据的设置。在三个训练随机种子下，全传感器检测的按运行平均窗口 F1 分数达到 0.834–0.964。八传感器聚合在两次分流器调整运行中降低了跨传感器子集的检测分数波动，同时保持（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: InletScope 提出了一种基于多尺度压力的进气道不起动监测框架，通过共享多尺度编码、可学习尺度融合与传感器概率平均，在传感器配置发生变化时无需重新训练即可实现不起动检测和0.5秒内的新发事件预测，并在马赫2.9风洞试验中取得了0.834–0.964的窗口F1分数。
en_tdlr: InletScope is a multiscale pressure-based inlet unstart monitoring framework that combines shared multiscale encoding, learned scale fusion, and sensor-probability averaging, enabling unstart detection and onset prediction without retraining under changing sensor configurations.
